QUOTE: Row 2: "Channel stays in local DB with `delete_at` set" (viewable) vs "If it is the current channel, kick the user (`handleKickFromChannel`), and always `removeCurrentUserFromChannel`" (when 'false'); row 3: "`setChannelDeleteAt(now)` locally" vs "Calls `removeCurrentUserFromChannel` instead"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels are not viewable the user is removed (and kicked if it is the current channel), and when viewable the channel is kept with delete_at set (marked deleted).
